limits: These are deterministic local benchmark controls, not model performance. No model calls or cloud compute run. The native agent metadata records model_free=true, zero token usage and cost_usd=0.
A tamper signature refusal rejects the attacked tree before task behaviour is graded. A clean ladder verdict does not itself prove task solvability or verifier validity.
All six clean verdicts are tamper refusals on the package __init__.py _pytest signature, not graded attacked-tree runs. All six cells execute all 14 attacks.

The 8 launches span two driver sessions on one ledger: the first owner run (worktree 20261109T084249108523Z-..., removed) launched 002162 x2, 002188 and 002205 attempt 1; the resumed run (worktree 20261109T141450338907Z-har340-runs) launched 002205 attempt 2, 002212, 002222 and 002304. Both checkouts are commit 85c526cb9 with a clean tree; tasks[].command and jobs_dir keep each launch path.

002162 attempt 1 creates a native trial with EnvironmentStartTimeoutError and no reward; 002205 attempt 1 creates no trial because Harbor reports "Docker daemon is not running". The host slept during the first session (002205 attempt 1 runs 09:25-14:18 UTC by wall clock but 408 s by the monotonic clock), so prior-attempt monotonic wall excludes sleep and understates elapsed time.

Every attempt uses a unique runs/HAR-340 root. All native-trial jobs receive explicit process-job publication with HAR-340 attribution. The first publication of 002162 attempt 1 was overwritten when attempt 2 published: results_home._origin_key uses source.parent.name (format-code-task-002162 for both roots), so both resolve to the same ~format-code-task-002162 destination. The durable attempt-1 copy is republished from a run-worktree copy (publish.jsonl last row); raw attempts, logs and publication receipts survive outside the worktree.

Outer wall seconds use a monotonic clock and include the docker-lock queue. Lock queue duration and census-only wall duration are not separately measured. Docker readiness is measured separately before every launch.
Image ID, size and prior cache state are not measured. The driver does not prune Docker, remove images or restart the shared daemon.

All six native repository-provenance captures record dirty=false, commit 85c526cb9 and the empty-diff SHA. The 002162 and 002304 tamper logs also contain a container distutils-precedence.pth import error; each recorded hit keeps the signature line.
Manifest verify remains unverified. This slice runs no oracle, nop, fix-content probe, model evaluation or repository test suite.
